title: Desktop Support Engineer
company: KG Information System Private Limited ( KGiSL)
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled and service\-oriented **Desktop Support Engineer** to provide technical support to employees and ensure the smooth functioning of desktops, laptops, peripherals, operating systems, applications, and network connectivity. The candidate will be responsible for troubleshooting IT issues, maintaining systems, and providing timely resolution to end users.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide **first\-level and second\-level technical support** for desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT peripherals.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot **Windows operating systems and desktop applications**.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, OS, and connectivity\-related issues.
* Configure and troubleshoot **LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP**, and basic network connectivity issues.
* Install and configure computer systems, applications, drivers, and security updates.
* Handle user account creation, password resets, access\-related issues, and basic **Active Directory** support.
* Troubleshoot Microsoft Office 365 applications such as **Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint**.
* Maintain IT assets and ensure proper tracking of desktops, laptops, peripherals, and accessories.
* Perform regular system updates, antivirus checks, patches, and preventive maintenance.
* Respond to IT support tickets and ensure incidents are resolved within the defined **SLA/TAT**.
* Escalate complex hardware, software, network, or security issues to the appropriate technical team.
* Provide remote and on\-site technical support to users whenever required.
* Maintain proper documentation of incidents, troubleshooting activities, and resolutions.
* Coordinate with vendors for warranty, repairs, replacements, and technical support.
* Support new employee onboarding by preparing systems, creating accounts, installing required applications, and configuring access.
* Ensure compliance with organizational **IT security policies and procedures**.
* Participate in IT infrastructure maintenance, audits, upgrades, and other projects as required.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **Windows 10/11** operating systems.
* Good understanding of computer hardware and peripherals.
* Knowledge of **LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi\-Fi, and VPN**.
* Basic knowledge of **Active Directory and Group Policy**.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365 applications.
* Troubleshooting skills for hardware, software, and network issues.
* Knowledge of antivirus, endpoint security, and system patching.
* Good ticketing, documentation, and incident\-management skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical abilities.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and handle multiple support requests.

**Educational Qualification**

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc. / BCA / MCA in **Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field**.
* Relevant IT certifications such as **CompTIA A\+, Network\+, Microsoft certifications** will be an added advantage.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 2–5 years of experience in **Desktop Support / IT Support / Technical Support**.
* Strong customer\-service orientation and ability to interact professionally with employees at all levels.
* Ability to work under pressure and prioritize issues based on urgency and business impact.
* Willingness to work on\-site and provide support during extended hours when required.
* Good documentation and follow\-up skills.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Network Administrator
description:
**Job Summary:**

The Network Administrator is responsible for managing, maintaining, and securing the organization’s network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs, and firewalls. This role ensures network reliability, security, and the primary goal of Network Admin is to design, implement, and secure the network infrastructure for a S2M Health while ensuring compliance with ISO 27001:2022, HIPAA, and SOC 2 Type 2\. The Network administrator will also support EHR systems, Access Control, Fire Alarm Integration, and On\-Premises Networking while troubleshooting and optimizing network performance.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\. Network Administration \& Maintenance**

* Install, configure, and manage **routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers**.
* Monitor **network performance, bandwidth usage, and uptime**.
* Implement **network segmentation and VLANs** for improved security.
* Maintain **wireless networks (Wi\-Fi, access points, and authentication mechanisms)**.
* Firmware Upgradation and Configuration Backup
* Maintain Data centre in steady state level.
* CCTV and Access Control Management

**2\. Network Security \& Compliance**

· Configure and manage firewalls (Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Sonicwall, Sophos, etc.).

· Implement intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), Endpoint security, Advanced Threat Protection, Antivirus Gateway.

· Ensure compliance with ISO 27001:2022, HIPAA, and SOC 2 Type 2 regulations.

· Regularly perform network vulnerability scans and security patching.

· Firmware Review and Upgrade

· Configuration Backup.

· Network Hardening and Wi\-Fi Security

**3\. Troubleshooting \& Performance Optimization**

* Diagnose and resolve network connectivity issues, latency, and outages.
* Work with ISPs and third\-party vendors for troubleshooting and upgrades
* Deploying and Utilizing network monitoring tools (e.g., Zabbix, Nagios, SolarWinds, PRTG, Wireshark) to detect and prevent outages.
* Provide Level 2/3 support for complex network incidents and escalations.

**4\. Firewall and Remote Access Management**

* Support secure remote access solutions (SSL VPN, VPN, IPSec).
* Failover and Load Balancer
* Network Deployment.
* IPS/IDS, APP Control, CFS Control, Routing, NAT, APP Rule,

**5\. Disaster Recovery \& Business Continuity**

* Implement and test failover strategies for network resilience and Load Balance
* Ensure backup network connections and alternate routing in case of failures.
* Document disaster recovery (BCP \& DRP) network procedures.
* Critical Network Devices on HA
* Test and collecting Evidence for BCP without production impact.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

✔ **Education:** Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field**.  
✔ **Experience:** 3\+ years in network Admin, or Engineer.  
✔ **Technical Skills:**

* L2 and L3 level Network Troubleshooting.
* Experience with IP routing, VLANs, ACL, and subnetting.
* Familiarity with firewalls, IDS/IPS, Web Filter, Access Policy.
* Knowledge of wireless networking (802\.11 standards, WPA2/WPA3 security).
* Certifications with CCNA, CCNP are added advantage

**Project Deliverables:**

✔ Network Architecture Diagram  
✔ Firewall \& Security Policies Documentation  
✔ Network Monitoring \& Performance Reports  
✔ Incident Response Plan for Security Threats  
✔ Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP)  
✔ Compliance Report (ISO 27001, HIPAA, SOC 2 Type 2\)

**Soft Skills:**

✅ Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills  
✅ Ability to work independently and as part of a team  
✅ Excellent communication and documentation skills  
✅ Quick decision\-making and analytical skills

**Job Type:** Full\-time, Regular / Permanent

**Salary:** ₹3,50,000 \- ₹ 5,50,000 per year

**Experience:** 3 \- 5 years (Required)

**Qualification:** Bachelor's degree in computer science or IT

Pay: ₹350,000\.00 \- ₹550,000\.00 per year

* Provident Fund
